locations.name: Call Agent 14
locations.note:
Own and set up a Bunker, then call Agent 14 and request Bunker Research. Follow the mission marker and return the research to your Bunker. For a challenge requiring these missions, buying supplies or paying to fast-track research is not a substitute.

This week: Weekly Challenge — GTA$1,000,000 plus the Camo Ammu-Nation Sweatsuit. Complete three Bunker Research Missions during September 17–23.

locations.name: Duneloader inside your Bunker
locations.note:
Enter your Bunker and look for the loaded Duneloader marked with a blue blip near the entrance. Get in to start the surplus-weapons delivery, then follow the route to the assigned Ammu-Nation. If no load is ready, return later.

This week: Ammu-Nation Contracts — 2X GTA$ and RP. Bunker required; surplus weapon deliveries start from its Duneloader.

locations.name: Grapeseed Bunker
locations.note:
Open the in-game phone → Internet → Maze Bank Foreclosures, select the Grapeseed Bunker and check the displayed price before confirming. The offer is for this property; optional upgrades are separate. If you already own a Bunker, check the trade-in consequences before replacing it.

This week: Grapeseed Bunker — Property available for GTA$0. Claim through Maze Bank Foreclosures during the offer period.

locations.name: Los Santos Car Meet
locations.area: Cypress Flats → LS Car Meet map icon
locations.note:
Enter the Car Meet and check Prize Ride Challenge in the Interaction Menu. Join the required LS Car Meet race series and check your progress after each result. Consecutive-day requirements need separate qualifying days; collect the reward from the Prize Ride menu after completion.

This week: Dinka LSCM Jester RR — LS Car Meet Prize Ride: Dinka LSCM Jester RR. Win an LS Car Meet Series race on four consecutive days; collect through the Prize Ride menu after completing the challenge.

locations.name: The Diamond Casino & Resort
locations.note:
Enter the casino and use the Lucky Wheel in the main lobby. The podium car is a chance reward, not a guaranteed free claim. Check the wheel for your next available spin; availability can depend on your region.

This week: Vapid Dominator ASP — Casino podium prize: Vapid Dominator ASP. A Lucky Wheel spin gives a chance to win; no guaranteed award. GTA+ allows two spins per 24 hours.

locations.name: Mobile weapons dealer
locations.area: Daily rotating stop in Southern San Andreas
locations.note:
The stock below belongs to this week; the parking spot changes daily. Today’s exact stop is not verified in this guide. Without GTA+, the van icon appears when you are nearby; GTA+ members can locate it on the map. Approach the open rear doors to browse weapons and compare the price shown for your membership.

See This Week → Gun Van for the current stock and discounts.

locations.name: Freemode event cargo
locations.note:
Wait for a Business Battle in Freemode, then use the event’s cargo marker and delivery destination. Pick up and deliver the crates; the route is assigned by the event, not one permanent address. Check the current reward description below.

This week: Business Battle clothing — Six Figure Tee, Ride or Die Tee, Red & White Ammu-Nation Cap and Bourgeoix Tee are available rewards. Deliver Business Battle crates during the September event.

locations.name: Legendary Motorsport
locations.note:
Find the exact model named below and check its current price before buying. Astron Custom is the Enhanced-platform model; do not confuse it with the standard Astron. A discount does not make the car free.

This week: Pfister Astron Custom — 70% off. Available from Legendary Motorsport on PC Enhanced, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
